mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lucky_draw_prize (product_name, product_quantity, activity_id) VALUES (#{productName}, #{productQuantity}, #{activityId})
mapper.update: UPDATE lucky_draw_prize SET product_name = #{productName}, product_quantity = #{productQuantity}, activity_id = #{activityId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE prize_id = #{prizeId}
mapper.select:
SELECT p.prize_id, p.product_name, p.product_quantity, p.activity_id, a.activity_name, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM lucky_draw_prize p inner join lucky_draw_activity a on p.activity_id = a.activity_id
AND p.activity_id = #{activityId}
AND a.activity_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{activityName}, '%')
AND p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
ORDER BY prize_id
